entries.name: St. Pachomius, Abbot
entries.summary: Pachomius first encountered Christian kindness while imprisoned. He later became a leader of monks and helped shape community monastic life.

entries.name: St. Louise de Marillac
entries.summary: Louise de Marillac was a widow who devoted herself to charity. With Vincent de Paul, she founded the Daughters of Charity.

entries.name: St. Gordianus, martyred on the Via Latina

entries.name: St. John of Avila, Priest

entries.name: Sts. Quartus and Quintus, martyred on the Via Latina

entries.name: St. Matthias, Apostle
